en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a hilly rural town. In the foreground stands a large white multi‑storey house with a gabled roof, garden structures, fenced plots, and a few people working outside. A chimney stack rises on the right edge, suggesting some light industry. Beyond this are fields, trees, and farm buildings leading to a dense cluster of townhouses. Two tall church towers dominate the skyline on the left and near the center. The landscape of rolling hills continues in the background. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
